title: Man Holding Toddler Girl on Deck, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A deckled-edge black-and-white snapshot capturing a mature gentleman in a heavy tweed suit jacket and necktie holding a small barefoot toddler in an overcoat. The child wears a small hair ribbon and looks curiously at the camera, while the man smiles gently. They are standing on an elevated wooden balcony or deck bordered with wire mesh netting, with dense coniferous trees and natural hillside vegetation stretching out behind them. Handwritten in ink on the front lower border is 'Lynn and Peter'.
